PROPOSAL_SUBTITLE: Comprehensive solution for monoclonal antibody production and validation
EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY: AntibodySystem is pleased to present this comprehensive proposal for a custom antibody development partnership with Precision Therapeutics Inc. Leveraging our expertise in recombinant protein technology and quality-driven production processes, we propose a tailored solution to develop, produce, and validate monoclonal antibodies targeting your specific research needs. Our proven track record of successful collaborations with leading research institutions positions us as the ideal partner for this critical project.
WHY_CHOOSE: AntibodySystem combines cutting-edge biotechnology with rigorous quality standards to deliver exceptional recombinant proteins. Our Paris-based facility features state-of-the-art equipment, and our scientific team brings decades of combined experience in antibody engineering. We maintain ISO-certified processes and have successfully delivered over 500 custom antibody projects to research partners worldwide.
SOLUTION_OVERVIEW: Our proposed solution encompasses the entire antibody development lifecycle, from antigen design and immunization through production scale-up and comprehensive validation. We will employ our proprietary hybridoma technology combined with modern recombinant expression systems to ensure optimal antibody characteristics. Each development milestone includes detailed quality assessments and client consultations to ensure alignment with your research objectives.
BENEFIT_1_DESC: Our team of Ph.D.-level scientists brings extensive experience in antibody engineering, protein biochemistry, and immunology. We stay at the forefront of technological advances to deliver superior results.
BENEFIT_2_DESC: Every antibody undergoes rigorous validation including specificity testing, cross-reactivity assessment, and functional assays. We provide comprehensive documentation and certificates of analysis with each delivery.
BENEFIT_3_DESC: We adapt to your timeline and budget constraints while maintaining uncompromising quality standards. Our scalable production capabilities grow with your research needs, from milligram to gram quantities.
PHASE_1_DESC: Antigen preparation, immunization protocol design, and initial immune response assessment. Includes consultations to optimize immunogen selection and delivery strategy.
PHASE_2_DESC: Cell fusion, hybridoma screening using ELISA and flow cytometry, clone selection, and preliminary characterization of lead candidates. Delivery of 3-5 validated clones.
PHASE_3_DESC: Scale-up production, comprehensive validation (Western blot, IHC, IP), stability testing, and delivery of purified antibody with complete documentation package.
ITEM_1_DESC: Complete development from immunization through validated clones
ITEM_2_DESC: 100mg purified antibody with full QC documentation
